requirements_summary: Mid-market product analytics company building a user-facing chat assistant and semantic product search. Primary goals: predictable per-month inference cost, p95 latency <150ms for NA and <200ms for EU, throughput ~800-1,200 requests/sec for peak flows. Quality must match current LLM baseline for summarization and reranking tasks. Required features: token-level cost breakdown, per-route dashboards, rollouts/canary for model versions, SSO (SAML), audit logs and KMS integration. Preferred model families: smaller cost-efficient variants of open models (quantized 7B/13B) with pinning + automatic fallback to hosted variants during maintenance. Must support VPC/private networking for Dedicated deployment and contractual data residency in EU for certain customers.
